content:
[姜子润未妥善保管球拍，再次找回时已严重泡水]
新任活动部部长姜子润于6月18日下午遗失球拍，在今日(6月23日)上午大课间经过长达15分钟的找寻后，于操场跑道一长凳上找到。大雨之后，球拍与拍套严重泡水，球拍的黑红胶皮严重褪色变为灰、粉色。庆幸的是，该球拍仍具备较好的性能。姜子润本人已表示暂时不会更换球拍。对此，副社长任安喆提醒各位球友妥善保管球拍
content_en:
[JIANG Zirun did not look after his paddle properly, and when it turned up again it was badly waterlogged]
The newly appointed Activities Department Head JIANG Zirun lost his paddle on the afternoon of 18 June. On the morning of today (23 June), during the long break, after a 15-minute search, it turned up on a bench beside the running track on the sports field. After the heavy rain, the paddle and its case were thoroughly soaked, and the black-and-red rubber had faded badly, turning grey and pink. Fortunately the paddle still performs well. JIANG Zirun has said he will not replace it for the time being. With that, Vice President REN Anzhe reminds all players to look after their paddles properly
